intro.heading: Sixteen cottages. Pick the one that fits your family.
intro.body: Each cabin is fully furnished with linens, a kosher kitchen, and climate control. Sizes range from one-room suites for couples to roomy 3.5-room cottages that sleep up to ten. Use the filters below to find the right fit.

cabins.name: Cottege 1 - The 1 Bedroom Cabin
cabins.shortDescription: A bright one-bedroom suite with a 2-bed, kitchenette.
cabins.longDescription: Our small and peaceful cottage. This Suite is a single open room with 2 beds, a kosher kitchenette (microwave, fridge, sink), and a full bath. Ideal for couples or a parent traveling with one child.

cabins.name: Cottege 2 - The 1 Bedroom Cabin
cabins.shortDescription: A bright one-bedroom suite with a 2-bed, kitchenette.
cabins.longDescription: Our small and peaceful cottage. This Suite is a single open room with 2 beds, a kosher kitchenette (microwave, fridge, sink), and a full bath. Ideal for couples or a parent traveling with one child.

cabins.name: Cottege 3 - The 1 Bedroom Cabin
cabins.shortDescription: A cozy private cottage with a bright bedroom, kitchenette, sitting area, and private bathroom.
cabins.longDescription: A cozy private cottage with a bright bedroom, kitchenette, sitting area, and private bathroom. It has a clean, modern cabin feel, with wood floors, exposed ceiling beams, and a comfortable space for a quiet getaway.

cabins.name: Cottege 5
cabins.shortDescription: Cottage 5 includes two twin beds, a bunk-bed area, kitchenette, private bathroom,
cabins.longDescription: A bright and cozy cottage with a clean modern cabin feel. Cottage 5 includes two twin beds, a bunk-bed area, kitchenette, private bathroom, and an outdoor picnic space. A nice choice for a small family or a simple quiet stay.

cabins.name: Cottege 10
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, full kitchen — our most-requested summer cabin.
